CORRECTED_2026_09_06: THE FIRST VERSION OF THIS FILE WAS WRONG AND ITS HEADLINE SENTENCE IS WITHDRAWN. It said the committed values (C=19, F=0.918, G=0.424) 'were not reproduced by ANY of the eight orders tried' and concluded the published number is a property of the machine. An independent provenance lens found the defect in my own harness and I reproduced it. Corrected below.
WHAT_WAS_WRONG_WITH_MY_HARNESS: _probe_order.py replaced glob.glob with a shuffler driven by a generator that ADVANCES on every call. sensitivity() makes 135 runs and each of them re-globbed, so every grid point was scored against a DIFFERENT denominator join. No filesystem behaves that way: a real machine has ONE order and holds it. The values my table published (0.919, 0.921, 0.922, 0.923) are blends that cannot occur on any filesystem, and the blending is exactly what hid the committed 0.918.

THE_CORRECTED_EXPERIMENT.SCRIPT: CERT-V2/p1b_fixed_order_experiment.py (versioned; the earlier probe was not, which was itself a breach of step 14 and is fixed in this commit)
THE_CORRECTED_EXPERIMENT.METHOD: one permutation per seed, decided by the seed and the file name only, so every call inside a run agrees. This is what a different filesystem does.

COMMITTED_VALUES_ARE_REACHABLE.GATE_F_0.918: 2 of 8 fixed orders here; an independent lens found 16 of 33
COMMITTED_VALUES_ARE_REACHABLE.GATE_G_0.424: 0 of 8 here; the independent lens found the full triple C=19, F=0.918, G=0.424 together in 4 of 33

THE_CORRECTED_FINDING: The committed result is NOT irreproducible. It is UNDER-DETERMINED. The same bytes and the same code give one of a small set of answers, decided by the order the filesystem happens to hand the denominator files over. A machine that reproduces the committed numbers and a machine that does not are both running the shipped code correctly. That is a smaller claim than the one I first made, and it is still disqualifying for a certification: gate E certifies 'byte-identical re-run' and cannot see it, because both of its runs are in one process on one filesystem.

WHAT_SURVIVES_UNCHANGED.THE_MECHANISM: current_pressure.denominator_guard assigns den[id_survey] while iterating an unsorted glob.glob(); it is the only unsorted glob in the pipeline. id_survey is not unique: of 52,250 keys, 14,649 appear in more than one season file, 2,443 carry conflicting values, and 1,759 of those conflicts decide DROP vs KEEP. Reproduced independently, count for count.
WHAT_SURVIVES_UNCHANGED.THE_SCOPE: only OLIVO declares DENOMINATOR_VAR and only OLIVO moves. VITE reproduced to the digit under every order tried, by me and by the independent lens (33 of 33).
WHAT_SURVIVES_UNCHANGED.TODAYS_TEN_CELLS: STATE, VALUE, n_sites, n_visits, PERCENTILE and BASELINE_N are unchanged across every order tried. BASELINE_MEDIAN, which is also published, moves in 3 of 10.
WHAT_SURVIVES_UNCHANGED.GATE_J: a separate and simpler cause: a hardcoded /home/user path. Unaffected by any of this.
